description.en: Catapult Zombie can lob basketballs over wall type plants with deadly accuracy, making it a serious threat.
description.zh: 投石车僵尸跨过前方的植物，以致命的精准度向后排的植物投掷篮球，是不可小觑的威胁。

chat.en: Even with two ZCorp factories producing basketballs around the clock, there never seems to be enough.
chat.zh: 即使 Z 公司的两家工厂共同参与了篮球的生产制造，这些篮球也总是被一下子卖光。

text.en: crushes plants while driving down the lawn
lobs projectiles at the last plant in the lane
text.zh: 向每一行最后排的植物投掷篮球
